title: Color
slide_intent: Explain how a built environment can supply an identity palette. A reader can connect the colors of an abstract mark to materials seen at the laboratory.
strategic_value: CSAIL can preserve a link to the Stata Center while extending its palette for communications that require more colors than the logo.
demonstration: Seven labeled swatches sit above a circular diagram of tints and shades. The left column identifies brick, glossy yellow and metallic grey as sources for the logo.
practical_value: Use the primary three when the identity itself is at stake. Choose among the four supporting colors or their variations when a composition needs additional differentiation.
